RHEINHÜTTE Pumpen GmbH provides operating instructions for their vertical molten salt pumps.
The document covers product description, setting-up and installation, assembly, maintenance, and screw tightening torques.
Installation includes pre-assembly of the steel structure, transport, lifting, and final assembly.
Maintenance involves controlling rotation direction and maintaining elastic couplings.
Screw tightening torques are specified for vertical metal pumps.
The document provides operating instructions for vertical pumps.
It covers starting, stopping, maintenance, and troubleshooting procedures.
Detailed information is given on spare parts, gaskets, packing, and lubrication.
Additional documents include drawings and a list of lubricants.
Rheinhütte pumps must be used and handled according to the provided operating instructions.
Warranty is valid if pumps are used as intended; incorrect operation or unauthorized repairs void warranty claims.
Safety instructions include danger symbols, warning signs, and specific words for machine risks.
Operational personnel must have correct qualifications and understand the operating instructions.
Non-compliance with safety instructions can lead to serious consequences including loss of claims for damages.
Safety measures for user/operator, maintenance personnel, and unauthorized modifications.
Procedures for transporting and storing vertical pumps safely.
Important safety instructions for lifting equipment.
Guidelines for handling and packaging pumps during transport.
Pumps should be transported using eye-bolts and chain or a crane-traverse.
